name: digilytiks Consent Stats Lite
author: digilytiks

sections.description:
digilytiks Consent Stats Lite is a lightweight analytics plugin that helps you understand how users interact with your site’s cookie consent banner.

This plugin is intentionally focused on core consent interactions only, providing clear visibility into how often your consent banner is shown and which choices users make — without relying on GA4 or third-party analytics tools.

This is an early, simplified release designed for site owners who want basic consent insight without complexity.

What this plugin does

  • Tracks when the consent popup is shown
  • Records high-level consent choices such as:
    • Accept all
    • Reject all
    • Custom / preferences
  • Displays totals and simple charts in the WordPress admin area

What this plugin does NOT do

To set expectations clearly, digilytiks Consent Stats Lite does not:
* Track individual users or sessions
* Replace a full analytics platform
* Modify or manage your consent banner
* Support multiple CMPs (currently CookieYes only)

Support for additional consent management platforms may be added in future releases.

Features

  • Lightweight, database-driven consent interaction tracking
  • Simple visual dashboard inside WordPress
  • Designed to work seamlessly with CookieYes
  • No external services or third-party data sharing

Notes

This plugin is actively maintained and feedback is welcome.
If you have suggestions or encounter issues, please raise them via the plugin support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/digilytiks-consent-stats-lite/
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to digilytiks Consent Stats in your admin menu to view consent statistics
